targets.label: Position
targets.definition: Displacement of the particle at time t under the constant applied force.
targets.equation: x(t) = x₀ + c\,t\,\dfrac{q + q₀}{\gamma + \gamma₀},\quad q = p/mc
targets.note: Evaluated in this cancellation-free form to stay accurate at high beta / small impulse.

targets.label: Velocity
targets.definition: Instantaneous coordinate velocity of the particle.

targets.label: Beta
targets.definition: Velocity expressed as a fraction of the speed of light.

targets.label: Gamma
targets.definition: Lorentz factor — the relativistic time-dilation / mass-energy scaling factor. Diverges as β→1.

targets.label: Momentum
targets.definition: Relativistic momentum, linear in time under a constant force.
targets.equation: p(t) = p₀ + F t,\quad p=\gamma m v

targets.label: Kinetic Energy
targets.definition: Kinetic energy computed via a rationalized identity to avoid catastrophic cancellation.

targets.label: Proper Time
targets.definition: Elapsed time in the particle's own rest frame; always ≤ coordinate time t.
